title: The Frontend Dashboard WordPress plugin before 3.0.5, ProfileGrid WordPress plugin before 6.0.0.5 do not prevent an…
description: The Frontend Dashboard WordPress plugin before version 3.0.5 and the ProfileGrid WordPress plugin before version 6.0.0.5 contain a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to store serialized PHP objects in user metadata. These objects are deserialized when a public profile is viewed, enabling PHP object injection that can lead to arbitrary file write and potential remote code execution.
